title: Concatenation delivers later values before a delayed inner error
summary: Reactor delivered all four items before the identical delayed error. Hiding the callable source preserved the signals with one outstanding request at a time.

change.description: In delay-until-end mode, errors from a callable inner source are accumulated while concatenation proceeds to the remaining sources.

notes: Each pin's original FluxConcatMap and FluxFlatMap classes precede the same Reactor Core 3.1.1.RELEASE. The historical Gradle plugins are unavailable.
The physical callers run on Temurin 8u512, the Java major reported for Reactor 3.1.0.RELEASE.
With identical compiled caller bytes, 3.1.0.RELEASE, 3.1.1.RELEASE matched the parent and 3.1.2.RELEASE matched the landing on all three histories.
